v7.common_moment: a dip is flagged if 3 or more OTHER stars have a primary event of EITHER kind within 0.1 d at the same sector and camera (stage3_core.common_moment_n); it replaces the Stage 2 burst flag in the tiers, which counted only upside-down events
v7.pdc_check: a SAP-only dip whose PDCSAP flux (same file, same box length, nothing filled from SAP: sap_twin.load_pdc) shows SNR under pdc_min is tier 3; not measurable (PDC dropped those cadences) means no judgement (stage3.pdc_pass writes pdc_snr into groups_sap)

settings.sap_twin: v6: the SAP flux (crowding fixed, hard quality mask, nothing filled) of every SPOC and TESS-SPOC file in star-sectors whose best product is one of them, searched with the v5 settings; a dip PDCSAP also found keeps its v5 version, a SAP-only dip is added (merge in stage3_report.load)
settings.dominance: strongest other-kind event in the same light curve >= this event
settings.injection: 12 x 8 h noise, clipped to 1500..40000 ppm, 8 h wide, middle of the longest segment (stage2_search.do_group)
